LESSON: HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS - EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATI ON - NEGOTIATION SKILLS - EMPATHY - ASSERTIVENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.6: Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness, part of People and Relationships in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote healthy relationships in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain ways of sustaining healthy relationships in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explore barriers to harmonious relationships,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use strategies to overcome barriers to healthy relationships,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the need for healthy relationships in the community. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Healthy relationships - Effective communicati on - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learners speak clearly and effectively as they discuss barriers to harmonious

relationships.

● Creativity and imagination: Learners undertake tasks as they role play scenarios that depict effective communication,

negotiation skills, empathy and assertiveness in overcoming barriers to healthy relationships.
